evidence: Package README:26 explicitly names plugin marketplace list and plugin list as the admission probes; codex-host.ts implements those exact requirements. A numeric version floor cannot prove mutation-command support or authority. Runtime add failures are separately handled by the existing rollback/journal transaction and covered by the plugin-failure rollback/retained-journal tests in operations.test.mjs:65-75. Admission is not claimed to guarantee all later operations succeed. Thus the requested residual-scope statement is already present and the hypothetical mid-operation failure is an explicitly handled outcome.
